answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The quill of work and the haven of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a saffron to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
